CodeContent: "# Walkthrough - Print Detailed Balance on Receipt This walkthrough documents the full design and implementation of the **"Print Balance Details"** feature. ## Changes Made ### 1. UI Checkbox Addition (`pos-app/src/App.jsx`) - Added a new styled checkbox labeled **"Print Balance Details"** inside the Customer Balance / Due row: ```javascript ``` - This ensures the option is visible whenever a customer is selected, and it defaults to **checked (`true`)** upon customer selection. ### 2. Receipt HTML Injection (`pos-app/src/App.jsx`) - Modified the receipt HTML generator inside the `handlePrint` function to check if `printDetailedBalance` is enabled. - If enabled, it prints a dedicated statement block under the customer details section containing: - **Previous Balance/Due** (calculated based on order payment details) - **This Bill** (credit charge or change saved to advance) - **Net Balance** (post-transaction balance) ### 3. State Preservation in Orders - Appended `print_detailed_balance` and `save_change_to_balance` parameters to the order object during checkout (`handleCheckout`). ### 4. Build and Package - Terminated running POS background instances. - Successfully built the application into the unpacked folder at `pos-app/release-v2/win-unpacked/` using `npm run electron:build`. "
Description: "Update walkthrough artifact for print balance checkbox and template update"
